issues.description: The problem statement uses a different method name style for the total-students method: it refers to get_total_number_of_students() (with underscores) in the textual description, while the UML, later textual references, the template TODOs, and the solution use getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase). This naming inconsistency in the specification can confuse students about the exact method name/signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent in the problem statement by using getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) everywhere in the textual description, matching the UML, template TODOs, and the solution. Alternatively, explicitly state the expected method name and signature in the description to avoid ambiguity.

issues.description: The problem description (line referring to method name) uses snake_case 'get_total_number_of_students()' while the UML, tasks, and the solution implementation use camelCase 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()'. This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual method may confuse students about the exact method name they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Update the problem statement to use camelCase 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()' (matching the UML and solution) so students see a single consistent identifier to implement.
